alert_name: Encoded Payload Decoded and Executed via Bash

summary.description: An encoded payload was decoded using base64 and immediately executed through a spawned bash interpreter. The resulting process chain performed host discovery, process enumeration, file creation in /tmp, and network utility execution.
summary.risk_reason: Behavior is consistent with obfuscated payload execution frequently observed in post-compromise activity.

trigger_conditions: multiple discovery commands executed in same session
investigation_notes: Review parent-child process lineage around base64 execution
Review additional commands executed in session 21
Validate whether network activity reached external destinations
recommended_actions: Review user activity for session correlation
Inspect additional processes launched from the decoded shell
Collect filesystem artifacts for forensic review
